scope: Correct interpretation of isolated CALL gas in the exact installed Foundry build; preserve all earlier raw evidence and supersede derived labels/math only.

installed_forge.isIsolateMode_asserted_true: test/fork/RestockEfficiency.t.sol, corrected baseline seven historical cases

primary_sources.finding: Depth-one CALLs use transact_inner; its returned Gas records finalized transaction gas via tx_gas_used and separately records final_refunded. The synthetic transaction includes intrinsic gas.
lastCallGas stores the returned Gas total_gas_spent, refunded and remaining values after the isolated transaction has finished.

correct_formula.finalized_refund: vm.lastCallGas().gasRefunded; final, not an unapplied raw counter in this mode
correct_formula.outside_call_meter: gasleft delta + manually added intrinsic is a separate measurement including caller setup overhead and extra intrinsic; it is neither unrefunded transaction gross nor a second source of refundable gas.

superseded_interpretations.previous_label: Full-holder checkpoint refund-adjusted gas upper bound
superseded_interpretations.correction: Invalid derivation. Refund29600 was subtracted a second time from outside-call meter372366. The archived frameTotal345971 was already isolated receipt-equivalent usage, not pre-refund execution gas. New correctly labelled full-holder profile is required.

superseded_interpretations.context: Restock before/after matrix first integrated pass
superseded_interpretations.correction: Apparent large-pack net regressions came from the same duplicate refund subtraction; do not use the old sample-net fields as billed-cost comparisons. Compare corrected isolated frame totals instead.

unchanged_validity: Real counterparties, exact principal/mint-fee/artist-credit accounting assertions and their pass/fail results are unaffected by relabelling gas.
Historical logs retain the actual emitted numbers and exact source bindings; no raw evidence was overwritten.
Actual Anvil transaction receipts remain actual billed gas evidence for the candidate they exercised; they are not affected by the Foundry frame-label correction.
limits: Receipt-equivalent Foundry gas is not an actual signed-transaction receipt; final actual full-holder receipt remains a release evidence gap.
This correction does not itself accept Q360, revised gas quotes, continuous funding or owner economic outcomes.
The first forge test --help read was rejected by the local whole-suite guard, even though help was intended; no suite or alternative bypass was run. Primary version-specific source was read instead.
things_that_do_not_make_sense: A refund counter cannot be subtracted again after isolated transaction gas has already been finalized.
The same meter pattern appeared in several historical fork gas reports; their gas-limit/billed-cost descriptions need scope-aware correction rather than blanket relabelling actual receipts.
